name: Ghost PB Replay & Delta Pace Calculation Engine
greenMarker: ALL GHOST & DELTA PACE CALCULATION TESTS PASSED
note: A personal best is only worth racing if it was set without help. hintsUsedCount was once left out of the autosave, so a hinted run that survived an app restart came back looking clean and set a PB. This gate prints every check, passed or failed — '✅ [PASS] <text>' or '❌ [FAIL] <text>' — so expectFailure starts with '[FAIL] ': the bare text is in the output of a green run too, and credited any red run as the right reason (found 2026-10-14, Diary 130). Killer ghosts (KP-3) added 2026-10-14. Survival and duel ghosts (D19) added 2026-10-14: none written, and those already written are read as none.

mutations.name: a run that used hints can still set a personal best
mutations.why: The ghost you race is then a version of yourself that was being told the answers, and every later attempt is measured against a time nobody actually earned.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] Rejects PB record when hintsUsed

mutations.name: the ghost table forgets the kind of puzzle
mutations.why: Killer and classic runs share one slot per level. A killer Lv.3 takes several times a classic one, so a killer win never becomes a record there, and a classic player's Ghost chip offers a killer's time and board.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A first killer win sets the killer PB

mutations.name: a killer ghost is saved without its cages
mutations.why: A killer's givens are often none: without the cages the record's board cannot be dealt again, and Ghost quietly deals a new puzzle instead of the one the record was set on.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] The killer ghost keeps its cages

mutations.name: classic ghosts change shape
mutations.why: Every classic ghost already on a phone or in a backup has no kind and no cages. Writing them with a kind field makes the classic slot two shapes, and any reader that checks the kind treats the old ghosts as something else.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] The classic ghost keeps its old place and shape

mutations.name: killer ghosts are written but never read back
mutations.why: The killer slot is dropped when the table is loaded: each killer win is saved and then lost, and the Ghost chip on killer stays locked forever.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] The killer ghost reads back as 600s

mutations.name: a killer without a ghost falls back to the classic best time
mutations.why: Before the first killer ghost, Time Gap on killer would race the classic best time — a pace a killer can never keep, read as being far behind from the first cell.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] Killer falls back to the killer best time

mutations.name: a killer Ghost race deals the board without its kind
mutations.why: The givens come back as a classic puzzle: no cages, a handful of digits (none at Lv.5), and thousands of solutions the game will call wrong.
mutations.find: return isValidCageSet(ghost.cages) ? { ...puzzle, variant: 'killer', cages: ghost.cages } : null;
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A killer Ghost race starts as

mutations.name: a killer ghost with damaged cages is dealt anyway
mutations.why: A damaged backup's cages leave cells with no cage: the board draws holes and a cell no sum can decide. Dealing a new killer and racing the time alone is the safe fall-back.
mutations.find: return isValidCageSet(ghost.cages) ? { ...puzzle, variant: 'killer', cages: ghost.cages } : null;
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A killer ghost with damaged cages

mutations.name: the ghost's own pace is ignored
mutations.why: The banner's ghost count falls back to an even pace across the record time. A ghost that raced the easy cells first looks slower than it was, and the race is against a run nobody made. Nothing checked the timeline branch before 2026-10-14.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] At 300s the killer ghost had filled 35 of 81

mutations.name: Survival and duels borrow the Classic slot again
mutations.why: The bug as it was (D19): a Survival win writes the time LEFT on its clock over the Classic ghost, with the Survival board, and its pace runs backwards. The chip then shows a time the player never set in Classic.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A Survival win (420 s left) leaves the classic ghost

mutations.name: the rule names Survival alone
mutations.why: The fix rejected in Diary ③: a 1v1 or AI match still writes its duel time over the Classic ghost — a time set racing someone, which the best-time table has refused since BT-1.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A 1v1 win (90 s) leaves the classic ghost

mutations.name: the rule holds for classic only
mutations.why: Killer Survival (KP-2) comes through the same win path: its time left lands in the killer Classic ghost, and the killer Ghost chip offers it.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A killer Survival win (BACKLOG KP-2) writes no killer ghost

mutations.name: Classic has no ghost slot
mutations.why: The control: with Classic left out of the ghost modes nothing in Test 14 can change, and every 'leaves the classic ghost' check would pass on an empty table.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] Control: a Classic win sets the classic ghost

mutations.name: ghosts already written by Survival or a duel are read as they are
mutations.why: Every phone and backup that took a Survival or duel win before the fix keeps racing it: a time the player never set in Classic, and no Classic win slower than it can replace it.
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A classic ghost faster than the classic best time

mutations.name: a ghost faster than the Classic best time is kept
mutations.why: A duel's 90 s stays the Classic ghost over a 200 s best time — its pace runs forward, so nothing else can tell it from a Classic run.
mutations.find: if (!(typeof bestTime === 'number' && bestTime > 0) || ghost.bestSeconds < bestTime) return true;
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A classic ghost faster than the classic best time

mutations.name: a ghost with no Classic best time behind it is kept
mutations.why: A fast Survival at a level never cleared in Classic: every cell inside its 7 s bonus, so its clock only went up. The level's Ghost chip unlocks on a time left.
mutations.find: if (!(typeof bestTime === 'number' && bestTime > 0) || ghost.bestSeconds < bestTime) return true;
mutations.replace: if (typeof bestTime === 'number' && ghost.bestSeconds < bestTime) return true;
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A classic ghost at a level with no classic best time

mutations.name: a ghost equal to its best time is dropped
mutations.why: Every Classic win writes the ghost and the best time from one time, so every clean ghost is equal to it: dropping the equal one hides the Classic ghost of everyone.
mutations.find: if (!(typeof bestTime === 'number' && bestTime > 0) || ghost.bestSeconds < bestTime) return true;
mutations.replace: if (!(typeof bestTime === 'number' && bestTime > 0) || ghost.bestSeconds <= bestTime) return true;
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A classic ghost equal to its best time is kept

mutations.name: only a ghost exactly at the best time is kept
mutations.why: The best time takes the faster of two phones and the ghost this phone's (D21), so a clean ghost can be slower than it. Dropping those hides real Classic runs.
mutations.find: if (!(typeof bestTime === 'number' && bestTime > 0) || ghost.bestSeconds < bestTime) return true;
mutations.replace: if (!(typeof bestTime === 'number' && bestTime > 0) || ghost.bestSeconds !== bestTime) return true;
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A classic ghost slower than its best time is kept

mutations.name: a pace that goes back in time is not looked at
mutations.why: A Survival ghost slower than the best time stays: its timeline is the clock counting down, so the ghost's cell count jumps about during the race.
mutations.find: return times.some((time, i) => i > 0 && time < times[i - 1]);
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A classic ghost whose pace goes back in time

mutations.name: the stray check reaches the Speedrun slot
mutations.why: A Speedrun clock does go down — a combo takes seconds off — so the same test drops honest Speedrun ghosts. Nothing was ever written into that slot wrongly.
mutations.replace: const bestTimes = loadStats().bestTimes || {}; for (const l of Object.keys(records.timeAttack)) if (isStrayClassicGhost(records.timeAttack[l], (loadStats().timeAttackBestTimes || {})[l])) delete records.timeAttack[l];
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A Speedrun ghost whose clock went down (a combo) is kept

mutations.name: the stray check reaches the killer slots
mutations.why: Killer ghosts were never written by Survival or a duel; checked against the killer best time they vanish whenever the two disagree, for no wrong ever done there.
mutations.replace: const bestTimes = loadStats().bestTimes || {}; for (const l of Object.keys(records.killer.classic)) if (isStrayClassicGhost(records.killer.classic[l], (recordOf(loadStats(), 'killer').bestTimes || {})[l])) delete records.killer.classic[l];
mutations.expectFailure: [FAIL] A killer ghost with no killer best time is kept
